title: Thermal Gradient — Elevated Ambient
description: Ambient temperature P070 = {val} °C. Cabinet P071 = {val2} °C. Feed motor P072 = {val3} °C. All within spec but elevated vs seasonal baseline.
probable_cause: HVAC system in machine area running below capacity or unusual ambient conditions.
diagnostic_steps: Verify all machine air filters clean
Review duty cycle vs. thermal model
remedy: Request HVAC inspection for machine area. Clean all filters.
required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.
escalation_path: If THM-MD-001 is not addressed (log fault. schedule maintenance within 24 hours. reduce feed rate by 20%.), the fault will escalate in this order: THM-CR-001, then ELC-MN-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
